Sa racine permet d'obtenir une pâte dorée dont la principale propriété est de plonger la victime dans un coma de 1 à 10 jours. Klytun is a plant of grasslands and steppes, where its roots can be sought beneath open ground. Gathering it requires identifying the living plant before extracting the useful part. In a suitable habitat, its Find difficulty is Medium.

The root produces a golden paste whose distinctive effect is to place the victim in a coma lasting 1–10 days. This occurs after the general circulatory effects of the poison have begun; the coma does not replace them. The Resistance Roll establishes whether the substance takes effect and how severely the other effects develop.
